title: 第5章 第一案：518儿童被拐案（5）
slug: 崽崽捡破烂变捡尸警局追着颁奖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

李安国微愣。

一旁负责清点孩子的警员连忙上前解释。

“井里的孩子确实全部都救出来了，但石嘉熙并不在其中。

有孩子说看到他被一个男人带走了。”

石母眼泪唰的落下。

抓着李安国的衣服，哀求到，“李警官，你一定知道我们家孩子在哪对不对？求求你，求求你快去救他！

他从小到大没有离开过我们半步，他一定很害怕！呜——”

石母泣不成声，身体虚弱的跌坐在地上。

石父将她环抱，轻轻安慰。

“没事的，嘉熙小时候算过命，他……一定会平安回来的！”

李安国嘴唇微动。

想说些什么，但又全都憋了回去。

比起言语上的安慰，他想他们更需要的是找到孩子！

李安国转身，再次走进审讯室。

“赵南走的时候确实带了一个孩子，说是要送回亲戚家。”

“亲戚家在哪？”

“招弟村！”

警员立马递上资料。

“李队，招弟村原来叫下山村，因为村子太穷，娶不起媳妇，所以经常有人买孩子，延续香火。

二十多年前，我们打击人贩子团伙，就顺藤摸瓜查到过下山村。

现在下山村里，除了留守老人，其它青壮年都出去务工了。

生活质量提高了不少，孩子出生率增高。

但老一辈重男轻女的思想还是过于严重。

不排除买卖孩子的可能。”

“那就查！”

李安国率先起身。

不管这消息是真是假，他都必须走一趟！

“李队，审完了？吃点东西垫垫吧？”

任曼妮见李安国出来，连忙将提前打好的晚饭端上前。

李安国摇头，“你们吃吧，嫌疑人交代孩子可能被带到了招弟村，我得去看看。”

“那把这几包干脆面带上！垫垫肚子！”

任曼妮点头，转手就将桌上一袋零食塞到李安国怀中。

李安国今天中午出警就没赶上饭，晚上更是为了案子滴水未进。

再不吃点，她真怕孩子没找到，李安国就先倒了！

【招弟村？这案子和招弟村有关系吗？】

【没有吧……我记得人贩子的接头地点不是城郊废弃的码头仓库吗？】

【对对！我也记得是这，这批孩子有一部分被卖到国外，到现在都没找回来！】

【算算时间，还有十分钟船就开了，要是现在过去，或许还来得及！】

【所以这批孩子还是没能救下来吗？】

【啊啊啊啊啊！导演！不带你这么玩的！】

此时，李安国已经坐上了车。

脚刚放在油门上。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Li Anguo was slightly stunned.

The police officer responsible for counting the children quickly stepped forward to explain.

"All the children in the well were indeed rescued, but Shi Jiaxi was not among them.

Some children said they saw him being taken away by a man."

Mother Shi's tears fell down.

He grabbed Li Anguo's clothes and begged, "Officer Li, you must know where our child is, right? Please, please go and save him!"

He has never left our side since he was little. He must be very scared!Woo——"

Mother Shi burst into tears and fell to the ground weakly.

Father Shi hugged her and comforted her gently.

"It's okay. Jiaxi had his fortune told when he was a child. He... will definitely come back safely!"

Li Anguo's lips moved slightly.

I wanted to say something, but I held it all back.

Rather than verbal comfort, he thought what they needed more was to find their child!

Li Anguo turned around and walked into the interrogation room again.

"Zhao Nan did take a child with him when he left. He said he was going to send him back to his relatives."

"Where is the relative's house?"

"Zhaodi Village!"

The police officer immediately handed over the information.

"Team Li, Zhaodi Village was originally called Xiashan Village. Because the village was too poor and could not afford a wife, people often bought children to continue their family history.

More than 20 years ago, when we were cracking down on human traffickers, we followed the clues and found Xiashan Village.

Now in Xiashan Village, except for the left-behind elderly people, all the other young and middle-aged people have gone out to work.

The quality of life has improved a lot, and the birth rate has increased.

But the older generation’s preference for boys over girls is still too serious.

The possibility of buying and selling children cannot be ruled out."

"Then check it out!"

Li Anguo stood up first.

Regardless of whether the news is true or false, he must go!

"Captain Li, are you done with the interrogation? How about something to eat to cushion your bed?"

When Ren Manni saw Li Anguo coming out, she quickly brought the dinner prepared in advance.

Li Anguo shook his head and said, "You guys can eat. The suspect said that the child may have been taken to Zhaodi Village. I have to go and have a look."

"Then just bring these packets of noodles! To cushion your stomach!"

Ren Manni nodded and stuffed a bag of snacks on the table into Li Anguo's arms.

Li Anguo didn't catch up with his meal this afternoon when he was on duty as a police officer, and he didn't make any progress in the evening because of the case.

If she didn't eat something, she was really afraid that if the child wasn't found, Li Anguo would fall first!

[Zhaodi Village?Is this case related to Zhaodi Village?】

[No... I remember that the meeting place for human traffickers was not an abandoned dock warehouse on the outskirts of the city?】

【Yes, yes!I also remember this. Some of these children were sold abroad and have not been recovered until now!】

[Calculating the time, the ship will leave in ten minutes. If we go now, it might still be too late!】

[So these children still couldn’t be saved?】

【Ahhhhhhhh!director!I didn’t take you to play like this!】

At this time, Li Anguo had already gotten into the car.

Just put your foot on the accelerator.
